entities.name: Tatsumasa
entities.description: A legendary magical katana forged by Keisaku on Kamigawa, containing a Dragon Spirit.

entities.name: Keisaku
entities.description: A blacksmith on Kamigawa who forged legendary blades and was bewitched into forging Tatsumasa.

entities.name: Yamabushi
entities.description: An arrogant young monk who wanted a katana so sharp it could cut a promise and bewitched Keisaku into forging it.

entities.name: Dragon Spirit
entities.description: A dragon bound to the sword Tatsumasa, who visited Keisaku twelve years later.

entities.name: Kamigawa
entities.description: Plane where Keisaku forged his blades.

events.summary: The arrogant yamabushi asks Keisaku for a katana and leaves in a rage when Keisaku implies he does not deserve it.
events.quote: Keisaku implied that the yamabushi didn't deserve such a blade, causing the young man to leave in a rage.

events.summary: Keisaku finds a sealed bowl of metal on his doorstep, falls into a fever, and wakes to find the bowl gone.
events.quote: the blacksmith awoke to find a large bluish bowl of metal on his doorstep

events.summary: Keisaku, bewitched by the yamabushi, is forced to forge the blade binding a dragon.
events.quote: Somehow, the yamabushi had bewitched him, forcing him to forge the blade.

events.summary: Twelve years later the bound dragon visits Keisaku.
events.quote: Twelve years later, Keisaku was visited by the dragon he had bound to the sword.

relations.quote: one of the many legendary blades forged by the blacksmith Keisaku on Kamigawa
